title: The Photograph of Nothing
premise_public: A photographer took a picture of an apparently empty, dark warehouse. After seeing the picture, she immediately called the fire brigade.
solution_summary: Her camera's flash illuminated a thin cloud of smoke near the ceiling. Something was smoldering out of sight in the darkness.

facts.text: The photograph was taken with a camera flash.
The flash exposed smoke near the ceiling.
The photographer suspected a hidden fire.
Nobody needed to appear in the picture.

acceptable_solutions: The flash revealed smoke from a hidden fire in the dark warehouse.
A camera photo showed smoke near the roof and she alerted firefighters.
The picture exposed smoke she could not see before taking it.
hints: The photograph showed something the photographer missed in person.
Consider what extra light can reveal high above the floor.
